name: Menubar
description: A desktop-app style menubar (File, Edit, View, Profiles) whose menus fade and lift in, switch on hover once one is open, and support shortcuts, separators, disabled items, and checkbox items.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA menubar pattern: a role="menubar" with roving tabindex across role="menuitem" triggers (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, aria-controls). Left/Right move between menus (switching the open menu), Down/Enter/Space open a menu on its first item, Up opens on its last, Home/End jump. Inside a menu, Up/Down/Home/End move focus, letters jump by typeahead, Enter/Space activate, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger, and Tab closes. Checkbox items use role="menuitemcheckbox" with aria-checked and keep the menu open; disabled items are aria-disabled and skipped. Reduced motion removes the open animation.
